suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Strengthen XSS prevention guidance: clarify that ALL values interpolated into HTML must be escaped (including profile-derived fields like storeAddress, storePhone, storeEmail, storeHours), not just direct user input. The current guidance says 'Use sanitizeHTML() from html-utils on all user input' which omits profile-derived data that also needs escapeHtml().
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature cross-page-integration fixed an XSS gap where profile-derived fields in promotion-email-html.ts were not HTML-escaped. The fix added escapeHtml() calls for storeAddress, storePhone, storeEmail, storeHours, dateRange, and year.
